info.description: Open-weight small language model (8B total, 4B effective) that NVIDIA post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it, under OpenMDW-1.1 (Gemma 4 base under Apache 2.0). Tuned for multi-turn tool use, instruction following and input grounding in fast local voice/device assistants, interactive personas and edge interfaces. Text in, text out; the model card lists input up to 64K tokens and output up to 64K tokens without a separate total context figure, so context is unset. Thinking is toggled through the chat template (enable_thinking) with a runtime thinking budget. Hosted on build.nvidia.com; no official token price published.

zh.description: NVIDIA 基于 Gemma-4-E4B-it 后训练的开放权重小模型（总参数 8B、有效 4B），许可证 OpenMDW-1.1（Gemma 4 基座为 Apache 2.0）。针对快速本地语音/设备助手、交互角色和边缘界面，强化多轮工具调用、指令遵循和输入依据。输入输出均为文本；模型卡写输入最长 64K tokens、输出最长 64K tokens，未单独给出总上下文，因此上下文留空。思考通过聊天模板 enable_thinking 开关，支持运行时思考预算。已上线 build.nvidia.com，未公布官方 token 价格。
